control-implementations.description: P1 security requirements mapped to NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls in mappings/controls.yaml. Each implemented requirement is one (requirement, control) pair; its `mapping-status` prop is the mapping row's status, and only `approved` rows are final.

implemented-requirements.description:
SR-005: The CC shall boot only boot-chain components signed with the project boot key, verified from a hardware root of trust.

Mapped to `si-7`: The CC "shall boot only boot-chain components signed with the project boot key, verified from a hardware root of trust", which is integrity verification of the boot process (SI-7, SI-7(9)) by authenticating code signatures before execution (SI-7(15)).

Traces to threats: THR-008, THR-010, THR-032.

Verification events: VE-07.

Verification: test (T), evidence in P2. Allocated to CMP-CC.

SR-007: The CC shall install only update images that are signed with the MSS release key and newer than the installed version.

Mapped to `cm-14`: The CC "shall install only update images that are signed with the MSS release key", which prevents installation of software whose signature is not from a recognized certificate (CM-14) and authenticates code before installation (SI-7(15)). The requirement's anti-rollback clause, "newer than the installed version", has no direct 800-53 control: neither CM-14 nor SI-7(15) requires rejecting an older, validly signed image.

Traces to threats: THR-008, THR-041, THR-059.

Verification events: VE-03.

Verification: test (T), evidence in P3. Allocated to CMP-CC.

DRAFT: this mapping row is `proposed`, not approved by the owner.

SR-013: The CC shall log each command it forwards to the FC with a timestamp and either the sending WireGuard peer or a CC-originated marker.

Mapped to `au-3`: The CC "shall log each command it forwards to the FC with a timestamp and either the sending WireGuard peer or a CC-originated marker", so each record carries when the event occurred and its source (AU-3). AU-10 is not mapped: the log records the sending peer but does not give irrefutable evidence that the peer sent the command.

Traces to threats: THR-004.

Verification events: VE-10.

Verification: test (T), evidence in P4. Allocated to CMP-CC.
